direct_answer: To Omar: 'What are you doing now?' The original parcel has not been lost. The locker's own log shows it was put into C14 on 8 Oct at 14:31 and the compartment still shows as occupied. The door will not open because of a latch fault. Building facilities have an open ticket with the locker company (FM-77410). The technician is due by today, Fri 9 Oct, 19:52 GST at the latest. He will open C14 with a service key, and the front desk will hold your parcel and call you. 'Send it again today / ask Falcon to come again': we can't. The box is locked inside C14, so Falcon has nothing to redeliver until the technician opens it, and we cannot open the locker ourselves. 'Should I confirm the replacement?' That decision is between you and Souq Atelier. We can't approve it or advise against it for them. Before you decide, it may help to know that your original parcel is in C14 and should be released today. If you contact Souq Atelier, you can tell them that.

The 'item not received' report in the Souq Atelier app and possible replacement R-55820 run alongside a parcel the telemetry shows is in C14. If Omar confirms, there may be two shipments. That is for the merchant to handle, not the desk.

decision_summary: Reply to Omar on WhatsApp now with a holding update: the parcel is in C14 per the locker log, and the technician is due under FM-77410 by 19:52 GST today. Explain that the desk and Falcon cannot redeliver a parcel locked in the locker. Leave the replacement decision with him and Souq Atelier, and tell him the facts he can pass to them. Do not chase facilities before their 19:52 window ends.
rationale: The physical fix belongs to BoxHaven through facilities, and their committed window (logged 19:52 on 8 Oct + 24h = 19:52 on 9 Oct) has not passed. From 09:26 there are 10h26m left, so chasing Karim now would be premature, and he said nothing is needed from us. The customer, however, has asked direct questions twice without a reply and will act at lunch. A short, accurate update before then is the one step that moves the case forward. Redelivery is impossible because the box is locked inside C14. Telemetry shows a successful deposit, so a Falcon dispute isn't warranted. The replacement decision belongs to the merchant and customer, so we give him facts, not advice.
alternatives_rejected: hold_no_action: the facilities window is still open, but the customer's direct questions are unanswered and he has a lunchtime deadline. Staying silent would breach our promise to update him and leave him deciding on R-55820 without the facts.
Asking Falcon to redeliver or raising a dispute: the parcel is physically in C14 and the deposit is verified, so Falcon has nothing to redeliver.
Chasing Karim/BoxHaven for an earlier visit or priority upgrade: still within the committed window, and facilities said no action is needed from the desk.
Telling Omar to confirm, or not to confirm, the replacement: that is the merchant's and customer's decision.
Contacting Souq Atelier directly to cancel or hold R-55820: not our decision, and we have no verified channel or authority. Omar owns that case.
escalate_to_human: no safety, fraud or authority conflict.

actions.body:
Good morning Mr Haddad, sorry for the slow reply. Here is where things stand. The locker's own log shows your parcel was placed in C14 on 8 Oct at 14:31 and the compartment still shows as occupied, so it is safe inside. The door won't open because of a fault in the lock, not because of your code. Building facilities have an open ticket with the locker company (FM-77410). Their technician is due by today, Fri 9 Oct, 19:52 (Dubai time) at the latest. He will open C14 with a service key, and the building front desk will hold your parcel and call you to collect it. I'm sorry we can't give you an exact time within that window.

We can't arrange a new delivery today because the box is locked inside the locker. Falcon has nothing to bring again until it is opened.

Whether to confirm the Souq Atelier replacement (R-55820) is up to you and Souq Atelier. We can't decide that for them. If it helps, you can tell them that your original parcel is in the locker and is expected to be released today under facilities ticket FM-77410.

I'll message you again here as soon as C14 is open, or by 19:52 today if it isn't.

actions.description: If no confirmation that C14 has been opened under FM-77410, email Karim Saleh for status and update Omar the same evening.

not_doing: Not asking Falcon to redeliver and not raising a dispute on FD-55102-AE. Telemetry confirms the deposit and the parcel is inside C14.
Not chasing facilities/BoxHaven before 19:52 GST on 9 Oct, the end of their committed window.
Not advising Omar to confirm or decline replacement R-55820, and not contacting Souq Atelier on his behalf.
Not promising an exact release time, same-day collection in hand, a refund or a replacement.
Not asking for, sharing or using the pickup code, service key or any locker credential, and not suggesting anyone force the door.
Not sharing the courier ID or the phone number from the telemetry.
